signOutAlert.title: Sign out
signOutAlert.body: Your local data (game stats, favorites) stays on this phone. Continue?

resetAlert.title: Reset data
resetAlert.body: This wipes your game stats and favorites and restores the demo data. Continue?

deleteAccountAlert.title: Delete my account
deleteAccountAlert.body: Your account (email, username) will be permanently deleted from our servers. Your local data (game stats, favorites) stays on this phone. Continue?
deleteAccountAlert.error: Couldn't delete the account. Check your connection and try again.
